heroHeadline: Saudi-Led Coalition Strikes Houthi Targets Across Yemen; UN Envoy Warns of Return to Full-Scale War
heroSubtitle: The Saudi-led coalition launched wide-scale military operations against Houthi targets following the Riyadh airport strikes that killed three Saudis. Saudi Arabia and Yemen's government jointly called on the UN to take firm action. The UN special envoy warned Yemen has returned to full-scale war and urged all parties to return to dialogue.
footerNote: Data sourced from Saudi Press Agency, Al Jazeera, Reuters, AP, Washington Post, Bloomberg, NBC News, CNN, NPR, ABC News (Australia), TASS, Türkiye Today, Anadolu Agency, News.Az, Yemen Monitor, Arab News, UN OCHA, UN News, World Health Organization, Security Council Report, CFR Global Conflict Tracker, Trading Economics, and the US Senate Armed Services Committee record. Contested claims flagged with opposing perspectives.
